text: Trader: Look with your eyes, then.
Trader: Prices are prices. The road doesn't haggle, and neither do I.
Trader: Nine years I walked the salt road to learn what things cost. I don't sell that cheap.
Trader: Nine years, with a cart and a mule that hated me.
Trader: The mule died at the dry wells. I didn't, which is the only reason I'm standing here.
Trader: Sold it. The first thing I ever sold at a profit.
Trader: So am I. Most days.
